summary: Added a reusable Sonner-based basic error toast helper (gold border, #F5F5F0 text, 4s duration). However, the diff summary does not provide clear evidence that the helper is actually invoked in all required frontend error paths, and it includes unrequested backend changes (violating the 'no backend changes' non-goal). Deployment URL/checklist was not added in code changes.

missing_requirements.requirement: Wire the new basic error toast into existing error paths: invalid OTP entry, OTP send/verify failures, Internet Identity login failures, and dashboard profile save failures.
missing_requirements.reason: Diff shows imports of showBasicErrorToast in LoginPage and DashboardPage, but the provided truncated snippets do not show actual calls in the specified failure branches (invalid OTP, send/verify failures, II login failure, profile save failure). Evidence is insufficient to confirm wiring.

missing_requirements.requirement: After implementing and deploying, provide the draft URL and confirm checklist (no blank screen on login; toast visible on wrong OTP and failed save; UI stable).
missing_requirements.reason: No evidence in the diff summary of a provided deployment draft URL or an explicit checklist confirmation (typically would appear in release notes or a deployment note file).
